description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to generate significant stakeholder impacts in terms of (i) increased access and service quality achieved through the port's expansion; (ii) contribution to meeting the strong demand from Türkiyes diverse manufacturing industry and thereby supporting value-add and jobs; (iii) reduction in GHG emissions achieved through greening of the port infrastructure; and (iv) increased gender diversity in the workplace. The anticipated market creation effects are (i) to deepen Türkiyes connectivity to world markets by enabling the port to accommodate larger vessels; and (ii) the demonstration effect of MIPs expansion though a Green Loan as well as MIPs sustainability practices to other port projects in Türkiye and other emerging markets.

Mersin International Port (MIP) is the largest multi-purpose terminal in Türkiye by total throughput, providing container and conventional cargo services, as well as marine services in the southeast of the country, at the northeast corner of the Mediterranean Sea. MIP is looking to use proceeds of IFCs financing to expand its operations by increasing its berth and yard capacity as well as installing new equipment in light of anticipated capacity constraints.
